arStrings.szText: "You were one of the Askari attacking this pilgrim. Step aside."
Easy there. You want to go in? Fine by me. But I recommend you go back the way you came.
Intimidated by the Player, but trying to play it cool. This is a thug who knows not to pick a fight with the Player.
Unless you want to end up bobbing like driftwood in the port.
